title: Regression: First opening of Node picker in Inspector freezes editor for several seconds in 4.6.3
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible on 4.6.3.stable.mono
- Not reproducible on 4.5.1.stable.mono

### System information

- Windows 11 25H2 64bit
- godot 4.6.3.stable.mono
- GPU: Nvidia RTX 4070
- CPU: AMD Ryzen 7 2700
- 32 GB RAM DDR4

### Issue description

When assigning a node reference through the Inspector, the first time the node selector is opened for a specific exported property, the editor freezes for several seconds (typically 5-10 seconds).

After the first opening, subsequent openings of the same property are instantaneous.

However, opening the picker for a different exported property causes the same delay again, after which that property also becomes instantaneous.

This behavior was not present in Godot 4.5.1, where the picker opened immediately.

Observed behavior:

- First opening of picker for Property A -> 5-10 second freeze (visible blank window)
- Second opening of picker for Property A -> instant
- First opening of picker for Property B -> 5-10 second freeze (also visible blank window)
- Second opening of picker for Property B -> instant

The delay occurs every time a previously unopened node reference property is used.

### Steps to reproduce

create custom script node with to Node export fields, recompile project, try assigning node by node selector (click on assign button in inspector)

```cs
using Godot;

[GlobalClass][Tool]
public partial class ExampleNode : Node
{
    [Export] private Node nodeA;
    [Export] private Node nodeB;
}
```
